انزعجت (form VII)
# اِنْزَعَجْتُ (inzaʕajtu) /in.za.ʕad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
# اِنْزَعَجْتَ (inzaʕajta) /in.za.ʕad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
# اِنْزَعَجْتِ (inzaʕajti) /in.za.ʕad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
# اِنْزَعَجَتْ (inzaʕajat) /in.za.ʕa.d͡ʒat/: thir
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
